name: cart-dies
description: cart is at the Apartments window 9.5 s early (teleported there at 8 s: this tests Core logic, not pathing) and never fires. Lokier, holding the corridor from Truck, sees him at the recorded spot, and his scripted hit lands about 1 s later, time-shifted (cart 27 HP). cart then walks on toward the Balcony, into Lokier's angle: seen away from the window at a time the recording has no duel, he makes Lokier go LIVE, and Lokier kills him for real. The round goes on; the puppets nothing reached keep replaying.
